name: Abkhazia cryptocurrency mining technopark
notes: DCD reported Abkhazia's president said a new substation would power a technopark for cryptocurrency mining; JAMnews later described continuing mining activity and pending legal treatment. Treat as crypto/server-farm activity rather than conventional colocation.

name: Cloud9 - Batumi Arena
notes: DataCenterMap lists the Batumi facility at Shartava Ave 13, Batumi, as under construction. No public capacity found.

name: Kutaisi former Parliament building technology hub data center
notes: Government/press reports say the former Parliament building in Kutaisi will be converted into a tech hub including a data center for AI development. Capacity and delivery date not stated.

name: Innovative Technology LLC datacenter services facility, Ruispiri/Telavi
notes: Company service page gives contact/location in Ruispiri village, Telavi district and advertises colocation, server hosting, network connectivity, backup, and disaster recovery services. Public technical/capacity detail is limited.

name: BitFury Gori bitcoin mining data center
notes: Trade press reports BitFury's first Georgian data center was in Gori and cites a 20 MW operating facility serving bitcoin transactions. Current operating status was not independently reconfirmed beyond historical reports.
